briefdescription.para: Specialisation of DMat for ARingGFFlintBig matrices, backed by FLINT's fq_nmod_mat_t.

detaileddescription.para: Big-field counterpart of DMat<ARingGFFlint>: for GF(p^n) extensions too large for Zech tables, entries are stored as fq_nmod (polynomial-quotient) values and operations dispatch to fq_nmod_mat_* routines. Slower per-op than the Zech specialisation but unconstrained by field size.
